newsitem.title: UK: NatWest H1 profits suffer from markets loss.
newsitem.headline: NatWest H1 profits suffer from markets loss.

text.p: Britain's National Westminster Bank on Tuesday reported first-half, pre-tax profits of 669 million pounds and said the group has been hit by the underperformance of its NatWest Markets investment banking unit.

On a headline basis, the profit was up from last year's 302 million pounds but from continuing operations, the bank said it made 775 million pounds, a rise of 17 percent over last year. NatWest said it raised its interim dividend 10.4 percent to 10.6p per share.
